title: Tiny, cute banana
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='banana' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFC93C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0A020'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='peel' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE97A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8951A'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g transform='rotate(-18 50 55)'>
    <!-- banana body -->
    <path d='M30 32
             C22 38 20 50 26 60
             C33 71 47 76 60 72
             C70 69 76 62 76 54
             C76 50 73 48 69 50
             C60 55 48 56 40 50
             C35 46 34 40 36 34
             C37 31 33 29 30 32 Z'
          fill='url(#banana)'/>
    <!-- lighter inner highlight -->
    <path d='M36 38
             C32 44 32 54 38 61
             C44 68 55 70 64 66
             C62 68 52 67 46 63
             C38 57 37 46 40 39
             C40 37 38 36 36 38 Z'
          fill='#FFF3A0'/>
    <!-- stem -->
    <path d='M34 32 C33 27 35 24 38 23 C41 22 43 24 41 27 C39 29 38 31 38 33 Z'
          fill='#8A6A2A'/>
    <!-- stem tip highlight -->
    <ellipse cx='38.5' cy='24.5' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' fill='#C9A85A'/>
    <!-- blossom end nub -->
    <path d='M75 54 C78 53 80 55 79 58 C78 60 75 60 74 58 Z'
          fill='#7A5A22'/>
    <ellipse cx='76.5' cy='56' rx='1.5' ry='1.2' fill='#B98F3A'/>
    <!-- cute face -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='2.6' ry='3.2' fill='#4A2A10'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='49' rx='2.6' ry='3.2' fill='#4A2A10'/>
    <circle cx='46.9' cy='48.8' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='58.9' cy='47.8' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <ellipse cx='41' cy='56' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8A5C' opacity='0.85'/>
    <ellipse cx='63' cy='55' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8A5C' opacity='0.85'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M48 58 Q52 62 56 58' stroke='#4A2A10' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
